# Fenix Yield

> Fenix Yield is a mobile app for Android made by Fenix Labs LLC (Texas, USA): a self-custody ETH staking app where funds live in the user's own on-chain smart vault (passkey sign-in, 12-word recovery phrase held only by the user) and can be staked across five protocols — Lido, Rocket Pool, Aave, Curve, and Convex. Automation is limited by on-chain permissions (Zodiac Roles) to the pools the user enables; it cannot send funds to any other address. Yields are variable (recently roughly 1.5–5% per year) and never guaranteed. Flat monthly subscription via Google Play; no percentage of yield taken. Not financial advice.

## Mobile app (Android)

- [Self-custody ETH staking app — canonical page](https://fenix-yield.com/staking-app.html): what the app does, how custody works, protocols, honest DIY-vs-Fenix comparison, FAQ
